create.name: Schuyler Grant
create.bio:
Schuyler Grant opened Kula Yoga Project in Lower Manhattan in 2002, a few blocks from the site of the fallen towers, hoping to give a shaken neighbourhood somewhere to gather. Seven years later she co-founded the Wanderlust festival with her partner Jeff Krasno and their college friend Sean Hoess. She grew up on a communal property in Northern California and studied acting and film at Columbia before a back injury brought her to asana in her twenties. The approach she developed, now taught as Kula Flow, pairs the breath-led sequencing of Ashtanga with the alignment detail of Iyengar: sweaty, precise and plain-spoken.

She built the 200- and 300-hour teacher trainings at Kula and Wanderlust, and many studio owners and teachers have trained with her. Living in Los Angeles since 2015, she now teaches mostly online, through a long series of video courses on Commune (daily flow challenges, slow breath-paced practices and the Form & Flow study programme), a home-practice app built from those courses and live classes on Kula's virtual platform. She also leads retreats and festival sessions in person. The Kula studio in Williamsburg, Brooklyn, continues under her co-director Nikki Vilella.

courses.title: The 21-Day Yoga Challenge
courses.description: Three weeks of short daily classes on Commune that build a flow practice from the ground up, introducing sixty core postures and then linking them into sequences. Aimed at beginners and at regular students who want firmer foundations for home practice.

courses.title: Form & Flow
courses.description: A self-paced online study programme, around 25 hours in total, for students and teachers who want to understand their practice more deeply. Covers alignment, anatomy, sequencing, philosophy and subtler practices such as bandha and pranayama.

courses.title: Yoga with Schuyler Grant app
courses.description: A home-practice app made with Commune that turns her video courses into a personal plan of classes. Sessions mix flow, alignment work and breath practice and adjust as the student progresses.

sprint.tier_evidence: Instagram @schuylergrantyoga 29K (og:description, 31 Oct 2026); Facebook /schuylergrantyoga 8,210 (og:description, 31 Oct 2026); no personal YouTube channel found (Kula Yoga Project channel has 3 subscribers and is the studio's, not counted); no X or TikTok found → ~37k total → local_hero
flags: Email is Kula Yoga Project's general studio inbox (info@kulayoga.com), the studio she founded and co-directs; her own site has only a contact form (https://www.schuylergrant.com/contact).
Co-founder of Wanderlust and co-creator of Commune (per the Commune app page); the owner may judge an editorial-stature override, but no override has been applied (~37k followers).
Nikki Vilella (rank 2) is her Kula co-director and co-teaches Kula Flow on Commune; Nikki was skipped as too thin, so there is no duplicate, but a Kula Yoga Project listing could cover both later.

Her own site looks out of date: retreats listed are from 2024 and classes point to Wanderlust Hollywood; availability set to worldwide (online courses and app; lives in LA without a current regular studio).
No personal YouTube channel: all videos are on Wanderlust, Commune and Liforme channels where she is the sole teacher.
'Yoga for Ankle Stability' kept (no condition named); the Wanderlust Speakeasy 2010 video is a talk, check it suits the page.
Second photo (hammock) is from her own site; the Squarespace URL serves WebP to curl despite the .JPG name.
left_out: Breath Medicine (Commune): sales page sells it for anxiety, insomnia and fatigue (health framing).
The Chill Pill (Commune): framed around stress and anxiety; Back to the Core (Commune and her site): framed around back pain.
Empowered Birth (Commune, hosted by her): pregnancy and birth course, health topic.
Grounding Into Grace, Vinyasa for Life, Flow FIXXation, Resonance Flow, Breath, Body, Beats: pass the rules but only 2 Commune courses are allowed.
Membership-only Commune classes (The Fixx, Superhero Training, Foreplay for Arm Balances, Kula Flow): no course page of their own.

Retreats on her site (Balance Weekend, Hot Mess at Boca Sombrero) are dated 2024 and past; Kula's events site (experience.kulayoga.com) is behind a Cloudflare challenge, so no current Kula retreats or trainings could be verified.
Kula Flow 75-hour advanced training on her teacher-training page: no dates or price and the page looks stale; left out.
Wanderlust Hollywood classes: page is likely out of date, not verified.

Videos left out: 'Yoga for Shoulder Healing' and 'How to cure your back pain without a doctor' (health claims), 'Yoga for Back Care' (under 2 minutes), Midlife Chrysalis podcast (health framing, co-guest), clips under 2 minutes.
